national_news.title: India Positions Itself as a Key Future Exporter to China and ASEAN
bullets: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal stated during his official visit to the Netherlands that India aims to become a major exporter to China and the ASEAN region.
Bilateral trade between India and China grew by nearly 29% to $91.76 billion during April-September of the current financial year, positioning China as India's largest trading partner in H1.
India stressed reciprocal market access and commitment to fair trade, while raising concerns regarding Chinese export controls on critical machinery such as tunnel boring machines.

national_news.title: India and Liechtenstein Review Trade, Innovation, and TEPA Ties
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a bilateral meeting with the Acting Head of State of Liechtenstein, Hereditary Prince Alois, at Hyderabad House in New Delhi.
The leaders emphasized building momentum through the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA), focusing on trade, investment, technology, and innovation.
Prince Alois's official visit highlights growing economic engagement between India and the European Free Trade Association (EFTA) block.

national_news.title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum Concludes with Unanimous Joint Declaration
bullets: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded in New Delhi under the chairship of Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla, centered on the theme 'Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development'.
A unanimous Joint Declaration was adopted focusing on four core pillars: Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation, and Sustainability, alongside handing over the 2027 Chairship to China.

The declaration reaffirmed adherence to the UN Charter, condemned terrorism, advocated for ethical Artificial Intelligence, and called for due consideration of the Global South in global decision-making.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Holds Bilateral Talks with Liechtenstein Prince Alois
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held high-level bilateral talks in New Delhi with Acting Head of State of Liechtenstein, Hereditary Prince Alois.
Discussions focused on expanding trade, investment, science, technology, and innovation, leveraging the operationalization of the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement.
The visit included official meetings with President Droupadi Murmu and External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar to deepen bilateral ties.

national_news.title: Election Commission Defends Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Supreme Court
bullets: The Election Commission of India (ECI) filed a 248-page affidavit before a Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant defending its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
ECI clarified that statutory Form 6 for voter registration was not altered and that the SIR declaration was an independent mapping document framed under Article 324 of the Constitution.
Citing Article 324(5), ECI affirmed constitutional protection for the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) against restraint and dismissed challenges concerning Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs).
national_news.exam_tag: Constitution Article 324 / Election Commission of India

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates ESTIC 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the three-day Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC 2026) at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
The conclave brings together scientists, policymakers, and industry leaders to deliberate across 12 thematic areas, including AI, biotechnology, healthcare, energy, and climate sciences.
Key highlights include an exhibition featuring 150 deep-tech startup stalls and the 'Global Connect Networking Event' to strengthen international research and industry-academia collaborations.

national_news.title: 9th Asian Champions Trophy Hockey Tournament Begins in Punjab
bullets: The 9th Hero Hockey Men’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026 commenced in Punjab, featuring six leading Asian hockey nations: India, Malaysia, China, Japan, South Korea, and Bangladesh.
The week-long tournament is being hosted at the renovated Olympian Surjit Hockey Stadium in Jalandhar and Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium in Mohali.
The final and semi-finals of the tournament will take place at the Mohali stadium.

national_news.title: 33rd India-Singapore Maritime Exercise SIMBEX-2026 Concludes in Visakhapatnam
bullets: The 33rd edition of the Singapore-India Maritime Bilateral Exercise (SIMBEX-2026), hosted by the Indian Navy, concluded in Visakhapatnam.
The exercise was conducted in two phases: a Harbour Phase at Visakhapatnam and a Sea Phase in the Bay of Bengal involving Anti-Submarine Warfare, Anti-Air Warfare, and cross-deck flying operations.
Key naval assets deployed included Singapore's RSS Supreme frigate and India's stealth frigate INS Nilgiri, ASW corvette INS Kamorta, and P-8I maritime patrol aircraft.

national_news.title: MoRTH Introduces Concessional Local Pass for National Highway Users Near Toll Plazas
bullets: The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways notified the National Highways Fee (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026, introducing a 'Concessional Local Pass' effective from November 1, 2026.

Eligible non-commercial vehicle owners residing within 20 km of a fee plaza with a functional FASTag can opt for an annual pass costing Rs. 1,500 (outside municipal limits) or Rs. 3,000 (within municipal limits).
The pass will be non-transferable, available via the Rajmargyatra App from December 1, 2026, and will not apply to closed user-fee systems or plazas with available service roads.

national_news.title: Integration of Waste Pickers under NAMASTE Scheme and Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment highlighted the social security coverage provided to informal sanitation workers and waste pickers under the NAMASTE Scheme.
Beneficiaries under the Waste Pickers component of the National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) are provided Ayushman Cards under PM-JAY for comprehensive healthcare coverage.
The initiative aims to eliminate direct human contact with hazardous waste and provide social protection, tertiary healthcare, and financial security to vulnerable sanitation workers.

national_news.title: India to Amend National Anti-Doping Act to Add Criminal Provisions
bullets: Union Minister Mansukh Mandaviya announced upcoming amendments to the National Anti-Doping Act to introduce criminal penal provisions targeting doping violations by athletes, coaches, and supply chain networks.
India hosted the 3rd formal meeting of the Bureau of the 10th Conference of Parties (COP10) under the UNESCO International Convention against Doping in Sport in New Delhi.
An MoU is being finalized between the Sports Ministry, Education Ministry, and UNESCO to implement the 'Sport Values in Every Classroom Toolkit' across Indian schools.

national_news.title: Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 Organized at Dilli Haat by Social Justice Ministry
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment is organizing the fortnight-long Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat, New Delhi, from November 1 to 15, 2026, under the theme 'Prakash aur Parampara'.

For the first time, the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment and Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD) are jointly hosting the mela, bringing together Bharat TULIP and Purple Fest.

The event promotes economic empowerment for traditional artisans through Bharat TULIP (Traditional Artisans' Upliftment Livelihood Programme) and showcases inclusive participation for Persons with Disabilities.

national_news.title: Department of Telecommunications Achieves Key Governance Targets Under Special Campaign 4.0/6.0
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Ministry of Communications, reported key achievements under Special Campaign 4.0/6.0 coordinated by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG).
DoT successfully resolved 2,270 public grievances and disposed of all 640 pending public grievance appeals registered on the campaign dashboard.
The department generated ₹2.08 crore from scrap disposal and ₹2.18 crore from e-waste disposal while freeing 80,724 square feet of office space across 520 campaign sites.

national_news.title: India Aims to Expand Exports to China and ASEAN Region
bullets: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced India's goal to become a major exporter to China and ASEAN countries during an official visit to the Netherlands.
Bilateral trade between India and China rose by nearly 29% to $91.76 billion during April-September, making China India's largest trading partner in the first half of the fiscal year.
India emphasized commitment to free and fair trade, reciprocal market access, and addressing trade challenges including China's export controls on tunnel boring machines.

national_news.title: DAC Approves Defense Capital Acquisition Proposals Worth ₹2.12 Lakh Crore
bullets: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, cleared capital acquisition proposals for the Armed Forces estimated at around ₹2.12 lakh crore.
Approximately 82% of the approved procurements will be sourced from the Indian defense industry to enhance indigenous manufacturing.

Major approvals include High Mobility Vehicles, Light Multi Role Helicopters, Long Range Kamikaze Drone Systems, VSHORADS, Active Offboard Decoy Systems for the Navy, and Mobile X-Band Doppler Weather Radars for the Air Force.

national_news.title: Commerce Ministry Extends RELIEF Scheme for Exporters to March 2027
bullets: The Department of Commerce extended Component II of the Resilience and Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation (RELIEF) scheme under the Export Promotion Mission until March 31, 2027.

The scheme provides 95% risk coverage through the Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India (ECGC) for export shipments navigating geopolitical disruptions and maritime logistics risks in West Asia and the Gulf region.

Eligible cargo categories include Full Container Load (FCL), Less than Container Load (LCL), and refrigerated containers, while protecting exporter premium rates against surge hikes beyond pre-disruption levels.

national_news.title: ISRO Announces Expansion with Four Functional Launch Pads by 2029
bullets: ISRO Chairman V Narayanan announced that India will have four functional launch pads by 2029 to meet global satellite launch demands.
Plans include a 2,000-acre dedicated Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV) complex at Kulasekarapattinam in Tamil Nadu's Tuticorin district and a third launch pad at Sriharikota.

ISRO plans to conduct the first uncrewed Gaganyaan test within two months, followed by two more uncrewed tests before the crewed mission, alongside a collaborative lunar mission Chandrayaan-5 with Japan.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Emphasizes Zero Tolerance for Terrorism and Calls for Reformed Multilateralism
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that terrorism as an instrument of statecraft is unacceptable and cannot be justified or rationalised.
Highlighted the Global South's '4F' crisis encompassing finance, fuel, food, and fertiliser, urging the Global North to share equal responsibility.
Reiterated India's stance that dialogue and diplomacy are the sole solutions to global conflicts like Ukraine and West Asia, and called for reformed multilateralism at the United Nations.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates RBI's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Highlighted major financial inclusion milestones including nearly 60 crore Jan Dhan accounts and credit expansion via Mudra Yojana and PM SVANidhi.
Emphasized the critical role of modern computing infrastructure and specialized cybersecurity training in protecting India's expanding digital financial system from cyber threats.

national_news.title: GeM Promotes 'The AABHAR Collection' to Showcase India's Cultural Heritage and Support Local Artisans
bullets: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is promoting 'The AABHAR Collection', a dedicated digital storefront featuring 294 product listings from 10 State and Central Handloom and Handicraft Emporiums.
Integrates products associated with the One District, One Product (ODOP) initiative and Geographical Indication (GI) tags into public procurement.
Aims to provide effective market linkages for artisans, weavers, rural entrepreneurs, and women-led enterprises for government gifting requirements.

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Observes Vigilance Awareness Week 2026
bullets: The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare observed Vigilance Awareness Week 2026 with an Integrity Pledge-taking ceremony administered by Union Health Minister JP Nadda in New Delhi.
Observed from October 26 to November 1, 2026, coinciding with the birth anniversary week of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
The theme for the 2026 observance is 'Probity for Prosperity', emphasizing honesty, transparency, and ethical conduct in public administration.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Secures Top Position in Asia and 9th Globally in 2026
bullets: Bihar Museum in Patna secured the 9th position globally in the 'World’s 100 Best Museums 2026' list by travel platform Worth a Journey.
It is the only Indian institution featured in the global list and holds the top position in Asia.
The museum showcases regional history from the Stone Age to contemporary times, housing ancient sculptures, coins, manuscripts, and folk art.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Introduces 100-Point Performance Assessment Index for Banks
bullets: The Bihar government introduced a 100-point performance assessment index to evaluate banks, with IDFC FIRST Bank topping the ranking with 74 points.
Banks are classified into Green (11 banks), Yellow (7 banks), and Red zones based on their scores.
Bihar's Annual Credit Plan 2026-27 sets a disbursement target of ₹4.95 lakh crore, with the Credit-Deposit Ratio (CDR) standing at 60.17% as of September 30, 2026.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-MGIFRI Promotes Sustainable Orchard Management in East Champaran, Bihar
bullets: ICAR-Mahatma Gandhi Integrated Farming Research Institute (ICAR-MGIFRI), Motihari, organized a farmer awareness programme under 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan 2026' in East Champaran district.
The initiative focused on judicious fertilizer use, soil health management, nutrient recycling, crop diversification, and sustainable management of mango and litchi orchards.
Farmers were sensitized on utilizing organic resources like crop residues and farmyard manure to enhance horticultural productivity while maintaining long-term soil fertility.

bihar_news.title: Dispute Settlements Benefit Over 10,900 Bihar Gramin Bank Employees
bullets: Two industrial disputes between Bihar Gramin Bank management and employees' organizations were successfully resolved through conciliation by the Assistant Labour Commissioner (Central), Patna.
The settlements will extend financial benefits amounting to approximately ₹77.69 crore to over 10,900 employees, including recurring annual benefits of about ₹9.02 crore.

The first settlement benefits around 8,400 employees (₹67.17 crore) covering Performance Linked Incentive and wage enhancements, while the second benefits around 2,500 employees addressing the 12th Bipartite Settlement.

bihar_news.title: Bihar NEET UG 2026 Stray Round Allotment and Admission Dates Released
bullets: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) released the stray round seat allotment results for NEET UG 2026 medical and dental admissions.
Candidates participating in the Undergraduate Medical Admission Counselling (UGMAC) 2026 can download provisional allotment letters from the official website.
Document verification and reporting at assigned colleges are mandated within a strict two-day window.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Seek Central Assistance for Flood-Hit Farmlands and Fisheries
bullets: The Bihar Disaster Management Department (DMD) directed District Magistrates of 22 districts to assess sand and silt deposits on agricultural land and fisheries.
Deposits were caused by severe flooding from rivers including the Ganga, Son, Gandak, and Kosi, affecting around 50 lakh people.
Financial assistance will be sought under the State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) and National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF) norms to restore livelihoods.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi to Inaugurate Bhuj-Barauni Amrit Bharat Express
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is likely to inaugurate the new Amrit Bharat Express connecting Bhuj in Gujarat and Barauni in Bihar.
The 2,532-km long route spans four states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar, operating thrice a week.
The non-AC sleeper class train features affordable fares without dynamic pricing, aiding migrant workers and long-distance passengers.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Transport Department Blocks Online Services for Unpaid E-Challans
bullets: The Bihar state transport department issued directives restricting vehicle services like RC renewals, fitness certificates, and ownership transfers for vehicles with unpaid e-challans.
Vehicles with pending traffic fines can be blacklisted on the transport portal and subjected to seizure during routine checks.
The enforcement measures comply with Supreme Court directions to enhance road safety and penalize repeat traffic violators.

bihar_news.title: Strategic Relevance of India's Siang Dam Project Amid China's Yarlung Tsangpo Initiative
bullets: India's proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) in Arunachal Pradesh, valued at Rs 1.13 lakh crore, aims to counter China's massive Yarlung Tsangpo hydropower project.
The 11,200 MW project is designed for water security, flood management, and electricity generation in Northeast India.
Local indigenous communities have protested the project over concerns of land displacement, ecological damage, and loss of ancestral property.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Flags Off IndiGo's Gaya-Bangkok Non-Stop Flight
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary flagged off IndiGo's first non-stop flight from Gaya to Bangkok to boost international Buddhist pilgrimage tourism.
The twice-weekly international service coincides with the winter schedule expansion at Gaya Airport, which also includes operations by Thai Airways and Thai AirAsia.
The state government is working on a new policy to expand international aviation access and connectivity across airports in Patna, Darbhanga, Gaya, and Purnia.
